scientific_limitations: The main theorem is a finite minimal-separation result, not a new universal extension-count formula or an infinite-size classification.
Full enumeration is over all triangle-free graphs through five vertices, and only two specified graphs at six vertices.
Existing independence-equivalent graphs and general higher-tuple extension formulas are prior results.
A relevant 2012 independence-equivalence paper was inspected at abstract level only, leaving a residual unindexed-coverage risk.

The precise 2014-01-08 public date is that of the selected arXiv foundations source; Henson 1971 and Zhang 2012 historical publications have no independently verified day-level first-public dates in this inspection.
title: Sharp five- and six-vertex separation of finite Henson type spectra
